projects.title: AI-Powered E-commerce Recommendation Engine
projects.description: Built a personalized product recommendation system for a Shopify store with 50k+ monthly users. Integrated OpenAI embeddings with a vector database to match user behavior with product attributes, increasing average order value by 34%.
projects.outcome: 34% increase in average order value, 22% improvement in click-through rate
highlights: A/B tested against rule-based system — won by 34% AOV

projects.title: AI-Enhanced Customer Support Chatbot
projects.description: Developed a customer support chatbot for a SaaS company using OpenAI's GPT-4. The chatbot handled 70% of incoming support tickets, reducing response time from 24 hours to under 5 minutes and improving customer satisfaction scores by 40%.
projects.outcome: 70% ticket automation, 40% increase in customer satisfaction, 95% accuracy in issue resolution
highlights: Integrated with Zendesk for seamless ticket management
Achieved 95% accuracy in understanding and resolving issues
